card.name: Section-heading and transition words in labels
card.fires_on: Words that open a new clause or heading in drug-label text, such as 'also' in 'It is also not known whether', 'Laboratory' or 'Drugs' after a section number, and a colon before a bulleted list.

modes.label: 'also' before not known
modes.description: The word 'also' in the stock phrase 'It is also not known whether' in the pregnancy or nursing sections.
modes.example: It is<< also>> not known whether

modes.label: Heading word after section number
modes.description: The first word of a subsection title in the drug interactions or warnings sections, right after a number like 7.3 or 5.7.

modes.label: Linking word or colon in a sentence
modes.description: A colon or linking word like 'to' or 'without' that leads into a list or a phrase.
modes.example: the lack of clinical experience with the drug in these patient populations<<:>> • Known prolongation of the QT interval

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words and heading openers in drug label text, mostly in the interaction and warnings sections.
